generator_cmd: printf "%s\n" "$plain" | tools/bsdgames/usr/games/pig | tr -d "\n"  # bsdgames 2.17-35 `pig` (Ubuntu deb, dpkg -x into tools/bsdgames); the newline flushes the last word (pig drops a word still buffered at EOF)
oracle_cmd: [ "$(printf "%s\n" "$plain" | tools/bsdgames/usr/games/pig | tr -d "\n")" = "$encoded" ]  # bsdgames pig re-encodes plain to the exact bytes (no standard Pig Latin DEcoder exists; the oracle is the reference encoder)
note: Mastery-style fragment cut mid-word (deco -> ecoday); also lib.decode speculative free line (pig_free)
